newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: AND ends debut higher on Dutch bourse.
newsitem.headline: AND ends debut higher on Dutch bourse.

text.p: Shares of AND International Publishers closed sharply higher on their first day of trading on the Amsterdam Stock Exchange on Thursday.
AND shares opened at 3.30 guilders, reached a high of 4.55 guilders before closing at 4.00 guilders, with almost 750,000 shares changing hands during the day.
AND placed 600,000 ordinary shares at a price of 100 pence per share earlier this week with Rabobank which plans to sell the shares on to Dutch investors.
AND, founded in 1984 and listed on London's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) since July, now has a total of 21.3 million ordinary shares outstanding.
Its main businesses are electronic publishing, mapping and electronic identification systems.
